# Orient Fashions

> Orient Fashions (registered as Orient Fashion Exports (India) Pvt. Ltd.) is an apparel manufacturer and exporter founded in New Delhi in 1973 by Meena Sethi. It designs, develops and manufactures garments for international fashion brands in Europe, the United States and Canada, from five factories in Delhi NCR.

## Key facts
- Founded: 1973, New Delhi, India. Founder: Meena Sethi.
- Head office: E-45/14, Okhla Industrial Area Phase 2, New Delhi 110020, India.
- People: 4,400+. Capacity: 10 million units a year.
- Factories: A-1-4 Sector 7 Noida (1991); C-17 Sector 67 Noida (1994); 488-489 Udyog Vihar Phase 3 Gurugram (2000); B-4 Sector 67 Noida (2011); B-1 Sector 67 Noida (2017). Lace facility at 46/2 Okhla Phase 2 (1995). Central warehouse at A-3 Sector 67 Noida.
- Categories: women's and children's wear (blouses, shirts, dresses, occasionwear, ready-to-wear, soft woven pants, rompers, jumpsuits) and men's shirts, in knits and wovens.
- In-house capabilities: design, 3D sampling (CLO, Browzwear), fabric development, embroidery, digital printing, crochet lace, washing and finishing, in-house testing lab.
- Minimum order: 2,000 pieces per style, 1,000 per colour (flexible). Order to ship: 60–90 days. Sampling: 5–10 days.
- Sustainability: 20 certifications and verifications (including GOTS, GRS, OCS, OEKO-TEX STANDARD 100, ZDHC, Higg FEM, SLCP / Higg FSLM, AEO); 1 MW rooftop solar; 35% renewable energy, targeting 50% by 2028; net zero target for Scope 1 and 2 emissions.
- Memberships: Apparel Export Promotion Council (since 2002); Okhla Garment & Textile Cluster (since 2004).
- Contact: info@orientfashions.com (business), hr@orientfashions.com (careers). Office hours 9:00 am – 5:30 pm IST.
